papers.title_in_file: Unlocking the Power of Quantum: Applications in Production with D-Wave
papers.version_note: The text layer holds the document's pages 3 and 4 as repeats: the Recruit Group section and the closing paragraph appear twice (page 3 and page 4). Read once; the repeat was used only to check quotes.
papers.what_it_is: A 2024 D-Wave marketing white paper that describes three customer cases (SavantX, Pattison Food Group, Recruit Group) as quantum-hybrid applications in production.

assertions.value: The paper defines a production application as one that is actively being used by customers in a live environment, helping them to solve real use cases and deliver business value.
quotes: a "production application" means one that is actively being used by customers in a live environment, helping them to solve real use cases and deliver business value
assertions.certainty_reason: The paper states the definition itself in the introduction, p.1.

assertions.value: The paper cites a Hyperion Research report on quantum computing use cases in which 1 in 7 respondents indicated that their organization's main quantum computing activity was either a current proof of concept program or some form of production use for one or more business processes.
quotes: According to a recent Hyperion Research report on quantum computing use cases, 1 in 7 respondents indicated that their organization
main quantum computing activity was either a current proof of concept program or some form of production use for one or more business processes
assertions.certainty_reason: A result the paper attributes to another report; no sample size or date is given in the paper.
assertions.reader_inference: The figure counts proof-of-concept programs and production use together, so it does not measure production use alone.

assertions.value: The paper states that SavantX developed a framework called the HyperOptimized Nodal Efficiency Engine (HONE) that leverages D-Wave's quantum annealing technology, and that SavantX created a digital twin and generated data from more than 100,000 cargo-handling runs across a range of scenarios.
quotes: SavantX developed a framework called the HyperOptimized Nodal Efficiency Engine (HONE), which leverages D-Wave
quantum annealing technology
generated rich data from more than 100,000 different cargo-handling runs across a range of different scenarios
assertions.certainty_reason: A vendor describes its own customer's use of its product; no solver settings or problem sizes are given.
assertions.reader_inference: The text does not say how much of HONE's computation ran on the annealer.

assertions.value: The authors report that, after HONE, the terminal used nearly 40% less of its RTG crane resources for unloading, each crane traveled an average of 6,200 meters per day rather than 8,900 meters, deliveries by the cranes increased by more than 60%, and truck turnaround time decreased by at least 30%.
quotes: after HONE, the terminal was using nearly 40% less of its RTG crane resources for the unloading process
6,200 meters rather than 8,900 meters
The cranes also increased their number of deliveries by more than 60%, and truck turnaround time decreased by at least 30%
assertions.certainty_reason: Vendor-reported customer outcomes; the paper gives no baseline definition, measurement period or method.
assertions.reader_inference: The paper does not say whether the figures come from the digital twin or from live operation, and it does not separate the effect of the quantum annealer from the effect of the optimization model.

assertions.value: The authors report that Pattison Food Group developed an autoscheduling solution with D-Wave technology, deployed into production in 2022, which replaced a manual task of over 80 person-hours of work per week and resulted in an 80% time savings.
quotes: managing the driver schedules for those orders was a manual task that took over 80 person-hours of work per week
autoscheduling solution that was deployed into production in 2022 and has resulted in an 80% time savings
assertions.certainty_reason: Vendor description of a customer deployment; no measurement method is given.
assertions.reader_inference: The saving is against a manual process, not against a classical solver.

assertions.value: The authors state that the Pattison Food Group auto-scheduler can meet a threshold of 95% of the demand from the company's e-commerce shoppers.
quotes: The new auto-scheduler can meet a threshold of 95% of the demand from the company
assertions.certainty_reason: Vendor description of its customer's result; the paper gives no test data.

assertions.value: The paper states that the Pattison Food Group schedules must account for constraints that include which stores a driver is willing and able to get to, how many drivers each shift needs, and at least 10 hours between each shift.
quotes: which stores a given driver is willing and able to get to, how many drivers are needed on each shift, ensuring that time between each shift is at least 10 hours
assertions.certainty_reason: The paper states the problem setup of the case, p.2.
assertions.reader_inference: The sentence continues onto a page break and lists further constraints that the text layer does not complete.

assertions.value: The paper states that the Recruit team collected historic ad-watching data from a sampling of real TV viewers, estimated viewing rates with a machine learning algorithm, ran the quantum optimization to create proposed schedules for future broadcasts, then booked ads into timeslots and analyzed how the solutions performed in the real world.
quotes: the Recruit team collected historic ad-watching data from a sampling of real TV viewers, and estimated viewing rates using a machine learning algorithm
Then the quantum optimization was run to create proposed schedules for future broadcasts
Recruit employed the proposed solutions to actually book ads into specific timeslots and analyzed how these various solutions performed in the real world
assertions.certainty_reason: Vendor description of a customer workflow; no sample sizes are given.

assertions.value: The authors report that Recruit tested three solutions, the CBC solver, IBM CPLEX and D-Wave's CQM hybrid solver, and that the CQM solver consistently outperformed the two classical approaches and proved more robust with real data with more noise.
quotes: Recruit tested three different computing solutions
The results showed that the CQM solver consistently outperformed the two classical computing approaches and proved to be more robust with real data with more noise
assertions.certainty_reason: Vendor-reported comparison; the paper gives no problem sizes, time limits, solver settings or numbers for the comparison.
assertions.reader_inference: The comparison is against classical mathematical solvers on one customer problem; the paper gives no metric for the margin, so it does not support a general advantage claim.

assertions.value: The authors report that, with CQM, Recruit's solution delivered reach metrics 90% better than those achieved through manual scheduling methods.
quotes: reach metrics 90% better than those achieved through manual scheduling methods
assertions.certainty_reason: Vendor-reported customer outcome; the baseline and the reach metric are not defined in the paper.
assertions.reader_inference: The baseline is manual scheduling, not the classical solvers, so this figure does not show a quantum advantage over classical computing.

assertions.value: The paper states that millions of people in Japan are watching TV commercials that are scheduled by D-Wave's hybrid solvers.
quotes: Today, millions of people in Japan are watching TV commercials that are scheduled by D-Wave
assertions.certainty_reason: Vendor statement with no supporting data in the paper.

assertions.value: The authors conclude that SavantX, Pattison Food Group and Recruit Group have demonstrated that quantum computing is more than a research project and can be used for real-world production applications that deliver business value today.
quotes: SavantX, Pattison Food Group, and Recruit Group have demonstrated that quantum computing is more than a research project
assertions.certainty_reason: A vendor's conclusion about its own product.
assertions.reader_inference: The three cases use D-Wave quantum annealing and hybrid solvers on optimization problems. The paper does not show that the quantum component, rather than the classical part of the hybrid solver, caused the reported gains.
